title: Bar Juice 5000 Strawberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Juice 5000 Strawberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt delivers a tangy twist on a fruit classic. Juicy, sun-ripened Strawberry lays the groundwork with its soft sweetness, while Sour Raspberry adds a sharp, bright edge that cuts through for contrast. The result is a fruit-forward vape that’s both vibrant and balanced, ideal for vapers who like their flavours with a bit of bite. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid offers clear, well-defined flavour and discreet vapour production—perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with refillable pod kits, vape pens, and compact starter devices. The nicotine salt base delivers fast-acting satisfaction with a tactile yet smooth throat hit. Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts take the most popular disposable-style flavour profiles and adapt them for refillable devices, helping reduce plastic waste while keeping the taste you love. Choose from 5mg, 10mg or 20mg strengths to suit your preference.
